evidence.attributedDescription: Moving Pressure describes Cave as plunging into murkier terrain with fog, sinister atmospherics, sci-fi surrealism and grounded physicality; the bleeps are softened by a cavernous embrace, and the track is framed as hypnotic and unsettling in equal measure. This is attributed source evidence, not direct listening or raw-audio analysis.
evidence.listenerEvidence: The listener rejected the prior opening because each track changed energy; Cave therefore must not be admitted merely because it shares artist/label lineage and a close BPM.
evidence.craftConvention: A two-BPM reduction and shared body-first label language make this an auditable continuation hypothesis, but do not prove perceived-energy continuity.
